articles.summary: EVERETT, Wash., April 29, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Coastal Financial Corporation (Nasdaq: CCB) (the “Company”, "Coastal", "we", "our", or "us"), the holding company for Coastal Community Bank (the “Bank”), through which it operates a community-focused bank segment ("community bank") with an industry leading banking as a service ("BaaS") segment ("CCBX"), today reported unaudited financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2025, including net income of $9.7 million, or $0.63 per diluted comm
articles.title: Coastal Financial Corporation Announces First Quarter 2025 Results
